doc: Gaussian blur of the premultiplied layer (radius = kernel half width, sigma = radius / 3). Radii above 16 px run as a down-sample pyramid. threshold/knee (bloom building block): blur only the bright part of the image (soft threshold on luma). v7: `sigma` > 0 overrides radius (sigma in px, kernel half width 4 * sigma while that stays on the exact path (<= 16 px), else 3 * sigma, up to 600 px: the v6 adjustment blur has sigma == its radius, 0..200); `edge` 'hold' repeats the document's edge pixels outside the document (the v6 adjustment blur) instead of reading transparent. Legacy v6 Blur adjustment {radius: r} == {radius: legacy kernel half width, sigma: r, edge: 'hold'} (legacyBlurToFilter).

threshold.doc: 0 = blur everything; >0: only luma above it (bright pass)

knee.doc: soft knee width of the bright pass

sigma.doc: 0 = radius / 3; > 0 overrides radius: gaussian standard deviation (kernel half width 3-4 sigma)

edge.doc: outside the document: transparent, or repeat the edge pixels

vars: if(sigma > 0, if(4 * sigma <= 16, 4 * sigma, min(600, 3 * sigma)), radius)
